scientific_question: Does chronology-safe pitcher and platoon context improve future neutral batting outcomes beyond strong outcome-only projection, with exact outcome-only fallback?

estimand.name: neutral_batting_talent
estimand.definition: future terminal-outcome probabilities, wOBA, and batting runs per 600 conditional on a future PA in neutral pitcher, platoon, league, level, and park context

pre_fit_event_label_gate.purpose: attach one exhaustive terminal outcome to each context-eligible PA without fitting a model
pre_fit_event_label_gate.mlb_policy: reuse structured Savant true-PA event mapping and official two-strike substitution batter authority
pre_fit_event_label_gate.milb_policy: deterministic structured-event_or_narrative terminal taxonomy followed by exact player-game reconciliation
pre_fit_event_label_gate.failure_policy: an unresolved or nonreconciling player-game receives no contextual increment and retains the exact outcome-only forecast
pre_fit_event_label_gate.source_amendment_rule: target-free source-semantic corrections require a new version and hash before any fit; no correction is allowed after a candidate score

universal_base.role: strong outcome-only forecast and exact fallback
universal_base.fallback_identity: if context labels, matchup context, or fitted context effects are absent, every terminal probability equals B1 exactly
universal_base.coverage_policy: no player is dropped because matchup context is absent or failed closed

unchanged_base_nodes.IBB: not neutral batting talent; retain B1 conditional probability
unchanged_base_nodes.SF_MULTI_OUT_OTHER_OUT: retain B1 conditional composition; GIDP remains a separate opportunity model

pitcher_quality_feature.event_information_boundary: only outcome-ready PAs with game_date strictly before the current PA game_date
pitcher_quality_feature.prior_center: chronology-safe league-season-level event rate using only earlier dates plus previous-season carry
pitcher_quality_feature.reliability: implicit in beta_or_dirichlet posterior; no second multiplication
pitcher_quality_feature.identity_role: pitcher ID is a grouping key only and is never a transferable named feature

event_context_model.likelihood: penalized binomial per binary node and penalized multinomial for hit composition
event_context_model.linear_predictor: league_season_level intercept + batter random effect + pitcher_prior_log_odds coefficient + observed batter_side_by_pitcher_hand effect
event_context_model.platoon_center: weighted sum-to-zero within node and training origin
event_context_model.batter_effect_prior: zero-mean Gaussian with component variance estimated by deterministic marginal maximum likelihood from predictor history only
event_context_model.batter_effect_optimizer_failure: use node-specific context increment zero and preserve B1; never choose a value from evaluation results
event_context_model.matched_uncontextual_model: fit the same events, player effects, and penalties without pitcher or platoon terms
event_context_model.context_increment: contextual batter effect minus matched-uncontextual batter effect on identical event rows
event_context_model.increment_application: add recency-precision-weighted context increment to the corresponding B1 nested-node logit

multiseason_projection.weighting: node opportunity count times recency weight times inverse posterior variance
multiseason_projection.neutral_future_context: pitcher and platoon nuisance effects are set to their centered zero values

j1_forward_development.fit_pairs: only adjacent-season player pairs fully before the forecast target
j1_forward_development.V2022: J1 equals J0 because no earlier disclosed transition pairs exist
j1_forward_development.continuous_predictor_transform: training-origin mean zero and unit variance; store mean and scale
j1_forward_development.scale_invariance_test: multiplying any raw continuous predictor by a positive constant must not change fitted predictions beyond 1e-12
j1_forward_development.partial_pooling: all transition cells shrink to adjacent-direction and global means; no hard support cutoff

fit_protocol.variance_components: estimated from predictor-history likelihood only, never evaluation metrics
fit_protocol.D2022: fit using source and outcomes dated through 2021 only
fit_protocol.D2023: fit using source and outcomes dated through 2022 only
fit_protocol.D2024: fit using source and outcomes dated through 2023 only
fit_protocol.context_comparison_cohort: contextual and matched-uncontextual event models use identical labeled PAs

evaluation.metric_wise_comparator: lowest loss among B0_ONE_YEAR_EB, B1_MARCEL_345_K1200, and frozen failed C0_NESTED_EB on identical forecast-target rows
evaluation.context_ablation_comparator: matched-uncontextual model on identical context-labeled PA rows

support_and_subgroups.level_support: at least 100 players and 10000 target hitter-talent PA in fold-level cell
support_and_subgroups.other_support: at least 50 players and 5000 target hitter-talent PA

development_advance_rule.scope: eligibility to freeze a future 2026 confirmation package only
development_advance_rule.per_fold_proper_scores: J0 must improve terminal log loss and Brier by more than 1e-8 versus the metric-wise comparator in every fold and weighting view
development_advance_rule.pooled_proper_scores: J0 must improve terminal log loss and Brier by at least 0.25 percent relative in both weighting views
development_advance_rule.per_fold_rate_value: J0 must improve wOBA RMSE and runs_per_600 RMSE by more than 1e-8 versus the metric-wise comparator in every fold and weighting view
development_advance_rule.pooled_rate_value: J0 must improve wOBA RMSE and runs_per_600 RMSE by at least 1.0 percent relative in both weighting views
development_advance_rule.matched_context_ablation: pitcher_and_platoon contextual likelihood must improve node log loss versus the matched-uncontextual model on identical event rows in every supported node-fold
development_advance_rule.correlation_guardrail: neither Pearson nor Spearman may decline by more than 0.01 versus the metric-wise comparator in any fold/view
development_advance_rule.supported_subgroup_rate_reversal: woba_rmse worse by more than 0.002 and runs_per_600_rmse worse by more than 0.5
development_advance_rule.supported_subgroup_proper_reversal: terminal log loss and Brier each worse by more than 0.0005
development_advance_rule.j1_ablation: J1 is evaluated only after J0 passes; J1 must improve both proper scores and wOBA/runs RMSE versus J0 in every fold/view with no material supported subgroup reversal
development_advance_rule.selection: least complex candidate clearing every applicable rule
development_advance_rule.failure: document and stop without tuning; a failed J0 forbids J1

scientific_invariants: terminal probabilities are exhaustive nonnegative and normalized
removing matchup context returns B1 probabilities exactly
a failed-closed sidecar row returns B1 probabilities exactly
as context evidence approaches zero the context increment converges smoothly to zero
pitcher features for a PA are unchanged by adding same-date or future pitcher events
contextual and matched-uncontextual fits use identical PA outcome rows
rescaling a continuous J1 predictor cannot change predictions
target-year outcomes membership parks run values and centering cannot affect predictors
player and pitcher names are unavailable to the estimator
moving coherent probability from an out to 1B 2B 3B or HR increases value in that order
contact shape and tracking cannot alter J0 or J1
required_persistence: all variance components and fixed effects
exact commands dependency versions and deterministic artifact hashes

requirements: J0 and any authorized J1 development result passes
selected implementation coefficients and refit protocol frozen
eligible population and source hashes frozen
one-shot confirmation scorer frozen and committed
